sentences.text: Martin Pibworth became Chief Executive of SSE plc on 17 July 2025, having joined the company in 1998 as an energy trader and progressed through a series of commercial roles, becoming Managing Director, Energy Portfolio Management and a member of the then Management Board in 2012.

He was appointed Managing Director, Wholesale in 2014 with responsibility for SSE's electricity generation portfolio and associated capital investment, and joined the Board in 2017 as Wholesale Director, also covering industrial and commercial energy supply and SSE's Irish businesses.
Immediately before becoming CEO he was Chief Commercial Officer, overseeing SSE's Renewables, Thermal, Energy Markets and Energy Customer Solutions businesses.

sentences.quote: Prior to 1998 Martin worked for Eastern Power and Energy Trading, and Total Gas Marketing.

Thomas Brostrom joined in early April 2026 as managing director for international business and development outside the UK and Ireland.
Barry O'Regan remains chief financial officer.

sentences.quote: Today's announcement follows a robust succession process, led by SSE Chair Sir John Manzoni and the Nomination Committee with the support of independent recruitment specialists Korn Ferry.
sentences.text: Martin Pibworth became chief executive in July 2025 after a succession process led by chair Sir John Manzoni and the Nomination Committee with support from recruitment specialists Korn Ferry; he joined SSE in 1998 and had been a board member since 2017, overseeing renewables, thermal generation and energy markets.

In November 2025 management set out a GBP 33bn five-year investment plan to 2029/30 weighted to UK electricity networks, funded by operating cash flow, higher debt, around GBP 2bn of asset rotations and a GBP 2bn equity placing, and the shares rose more than 11% to a record high, with analysts positive on the added clarity.

sentences.quote: Transformational GBP 33bn fully-funded investment plan to 2029/30 represents a trebling of investment over the five-year period, with around 80% or GBP 27bn to be invested in regulated UK electricity Networks
sentences.text: SSE plc is executing a fully funded GBP 33bn five-year investment plan to 2029/30, with around 80% or GBP 27bn going into regulated UK electricity Networks and about 20% or GBP 6bn into Renewables and system Flexibility.

The largest share, roughly GBP 22bn, funds SSEN Transmission's RIIO-T3 programme, which with its 25% partner is expected to lift gross RAV to about GBP 30bn by the end of 2029/30, an approximate 30% CAGR.
Index-linked earnings were 60% of the total in 2025/26 and are set to reach around 80% by 2030.

sentences.quote: Management maintained its adjusted earnings per share targets of 168-193 pence for the 2026/27 financial year and 225-250 pence for 2029/30
sentences.text: Management maintained adjusted EPS targets of 168-193 pence for 2026/27 and 225-250 pence for 2029/30.
The full-year dividend rose 7% to 68.7p alongside record investment, and 92% of debt is fixed at about 4.1% with net debt to EBITDA stable at 3.3 times.
